findings.message: 7 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "The Cold Stone experience", "✦", "Menu categories", "Menu items").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 2 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: oklab(0.999994 0.0000455678 0.0000200868 / 0.25) 0px 0px 0px 1px | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 24px 60px 0px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.

findings.message: 30 icons sit in tinted squares or circles.
findings.fix: This is the commonest tell of a generated dashboard. Drop the tinted square: a KPI is a label and a number; an icon, if it helps, is plain and in the text colour.

findings.message: 56% of the first screen is strongly coloured.
findings.fix: Keep the screen neutral and spend colour on data and status: the studied screens sit near 3%, and only tinted styles reach 10–15%, as pale tints rather than saturated fills.

findings.message: 4 text blocks under 11px: Menu categories 10px, Menu items 10px, Signature creations 10px, Free app 10px.

findings.fix: An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Menu items" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Cold Stone Creamery" (screen 10, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
